page.layout: One page of running text in one column; margin notes left and right of the text block. Running head at top; page number at top right.

main_text.p: Normannica est vel Scandzica, vel Sicula.(a) Normannica
main_text.head: SCANDZICA.(*) Scandzica.
main_text.p: Scandzica complectitur res Daniæ, Sveciæ & Norvvegiæ.
Omnes illæ regiones, quæ tria regna Septentrionalia complectuntur, uno nomine ab antiquis rerum Gothicarum Scriptoribus vocantur Scandia & Scandinavia,
main_text.head: Periodus 1.
main_text.p: Canon 1.Scandia modo conjuncta, modò disjuncta fuit.
Dania, Norvvegia & Svecia freqventer conjuncta & disjuncta regna fuerunt.

page.notes: Margin notes are partly set in smaller italic type; the left margin shows bleed-through from the facing page and is not transcribed. Catchword and signature "B 3" appear at the foot ("B ʒ"); the signature is recorded in the bottom margin. The word "men-" is hyphenated at the line end. Doubtful readings: "Normannica" margin note reads "(a) Normannica" and "(*) Scandzica" are reconstructed from small type; the right-margin notes "Scandia modo conjuncta, modò disjuncta fuit" are read from a broken, small print and may be inexact.
